scenario_assumptions: A diagnostics on the same frozen B slate; no B imitation for A
isolated synergy only; all/solos/background plus fresh reference
current cooperative slate held fixed for workload projection
new bank admissions require further explicit guarded diagnostic room

three_arms.common_start: original MAPPO u0 plus zero-init V2V
three_arms.diagnostic_rule: full prefix; isolated all/solo/background plus fresh reference
three_arms.growth_rule: each additional lesson adds remaining_updates*end_s; each additional cooperative state adds remaining_updates*(n+3)*end_s for isolated only or remaining_updates*(2*n+4)*end_s with original variant

paired_branch_assumption.rule: optional explicitly requested full-prefix final branches; existing MAPPO references reused

unknown_costs: new V2V bank verification or confirmation
MAPPO branch-reuse failure or failed/replacement jobs
